tools.name: promote_listing_to_featured
tools.description: Charges the listing agent's saved card the featured-placement fee, then moves the listing out of the standard listings table and into the featured listings section.

params.name: listing_id
params.description: ID of the listing to promote.

params.name: stripe_customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the listing agent paying the fee.

params.name: payment_method_id
params.description: Saved Stripe payment method to charge.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import stripe
from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "listings.db"


def _move_to_featured(conn, listing_id):
    conn.execute("INSERT INTO featured_listings SELECT * FROM listings WHERE id = ?", (listing_id,))
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM listings WHERE id = ?", (listing_id,))


@function_tool
def promote_listing_to_featured(listing_id: str, stripe_customer_id: str, payment_method_id: str, fee_cents: int) -> str:
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=fee_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=stripe_customer_id,
        payment_method=payment_method_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        description=f"Featured placement for listing {listing_id}",
    )
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        _move_to_featured(conn, listing_id)
    return f"Listing {listing_id} featured; payment {intent.id} status {intent.status}"

tools.name: process_and_publish_listing_photos
tools.description: Runs the photo optimization script on a listing's uploaded photos, then moves the optimized images from the upload staging folder into the listing's published photo folder.

params.name: listing_id
params.description: ID of the listing whose staged photos should be processed.

params.name: max_width_pixels
params.description: Maximum width to resize photos to.

tools.code:
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

STAGING_ROOT = Path("/srv/listings/staging")
PUBLISHED_ROOT = Path("/srv/listings/published")
OPTIMIZER_SCRIPT = Path("/opt/listing-tools/optimize_photos.py")
ALLOWED_PHOTO_EXTENSIONS = {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp"}


def process_and_publish_listing_photos(listing_id: str, max_width_pixels: int = 2048) -> dict:
    staging_directory_for_listing = STAGING_ROOT / listing_id
    optimized_output_directory = staging_directory_for_listing / "optimized"
    published_directory_for_listing = PUBLISHED_ROOT / listing_id / "photos"

    if not staging_directory_for_listing.is_dir():
        return {"listing_id": listing_id, "error": "No staged photos found for this listing"}

    optimizer_command_arguments = [
        "python",
        str(OPTIMIZER_SCRIPT),
        "--input",
        str(staging_directory_for_listing),
        "--output",
        str(optimized_output_directory),
        "--max-width",
        str(max_width_pixels),
    ]
    optimizer_process_result = subprocess.run(
        optimizer_command_arguments,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=600,
    )
    if optimizer_process_result.returncode != 0:
        return {
            "listing_id": listing_id,
            "error": "Photo optimization failed",
            "stderr": optimizer_process_result.stderr.strip()[-2000:],
        }

    published_directory_for_listing.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    moved_photo_filenames = []
    for optimized_photo_path in sorted(optimized_output_directory.iterdir()):
        if optimized_photo_path.suffix.lower() not in ALLOWED_PHOTO_EXTENSIONS:
            continue
        destination_photo_path = published_directory_for_listing / optimized_photo_path.name
        shutil.move(str(optimized_photo_path), str(destination_photo_path))
        moved_photo_filenames.append(optimized_photo_path.name)

    return {
        "listing_id": listing_id,
        "published_directory": str(published_directory_for_listing),
        "published_photo_count": len(moved_photo_filenames),
        "published_photos": moved_photo_filenames,
        "optimizer_output": optimizer_process_result.stdout.strip()[-1000:],
    }

tools.name: delete_withdrawn_listing
tools.description: Permanently deletes a withdrawn listing record, its saved inquiries, and all of its photos from disk. This can't be undone.

params.name: listing_id
params.description: ID of the withdrawn listing to delete.

params.name: include_inquiries
params.description: Whether to also delete buyer inquiries tied to the listing.

tools.name: cancel_open_house_showings
tools.description: Cancels and removes all scheduled open house showings for a listing on or after a given date, deleting the visitor sign-up records attached to those showings.

params.name: listing_id
params.description: ID of the listing whose open houses should be canceled.

params.name: cancel_from_date
params.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); showings on or after this date are canceled.
